scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const folders=['config','controllers','jobs','middleware','models','routes','services','sockets','utils','validators']; for(const folder of folders){for(const file of fs.readdirSync(folder).filter(name=>name.endsWith('.js'))){require('./'+folder+'/'+file)}} console.log('Backend modules validated')"
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run validate
